samples.title: What time is it - Time for breakfast

diff_details.en: Are you ready?
diff_details.old: 准备好了吗？

diff_details.en: Time for bed.
diff_details.old: 睡觉时间到了。

diff_details.en: Thanksgiving,
diff_details.old: 感恩节，
diff_details.new: 但在两个国家，感恩节都是一年中非常愉快的时候。

diff_details.en: an important holiday in North America, is held during the fall or autumn season of the year.
diff_details.old: 北美一个重要的节日，在每年的秋季或秋天举行。

diff_details.en: This holiday is called Thanksgiving.
diff_details.old: 这个节日被称为感恩节。

diff_details.en: At this time of year, people join with their relatives to reflect upon their good fortune.
diff_details.old: 在这个时候，人们会与他们的亲戚团聚，反思他们的好运。

diff_details.en: Thanksgiving is a holiday that has a long history in North America.
diff_details.old: 感恩节在北美有着悠久的历史。

diff_details.en: It was first celebrated when English settlers arrived in the eastern part of what is now the United States during the 17th century.
diff_details.old: 它是在17世纪，当英国定居者到达现在美国东部的地区时首次庆祝的。

diff_details.en: When they survived the first hard year, they celebrated and gave thanks to God.
diff_details.old: 他们在经历了第一年的艰难之后幸存下来，庆祝并感谢上帝。

diff_details.en: They invited some of the Native people to their Thanksgiving celebration.
diff_details.old: 他们邀请了部分土著人到他们的感恩节庆祝活动中。

diff_details.en: Because the native people had helped them to survive during the hard winter, the tradition of celebrating Thanksgiving continued and spread throughout North America.
diff_details.old: 因为土著人在艰难的冬天帮助他们生存，庆祝感恩节的习俗得以延续并在北美传播开来。

diff_details.en: Each fall, during the time of the autumn harvest, people celebrated Thanksgiving.
diff_details.old: 每年秋天，在收获的季节，人们都会庆祝感恩节。

diff_details.en: They gave thanks for the food of the harvest and for all the good things in their lives.
diff_details.old: 他们为收获的食物以及生活中所有美好的事物表示感谢。

diff_details.en: Today, the tradition of Thanksgiving celebration continues.
diff_details.old: 如今，感恩节的庆祝传统仍在继续。

diff_details.en: Families gather to eat a large bird called a Turkey.
diff_details.old: 家人聚在一起吃一只叫做火鸡的大鸟。

diff_details.en: They also eat pumpkin pie.
diff_details.old: 他们还会吃南瓜派。

diff_details.en: This is a sweet dessert that is made from a large orange vegetable that grows on the ground.
diff_details.old: 这是一种甜点，由一种生长在地上的大橙子蔬菜制成。

diff_details.en: In the United States, Thanksgiving is celebrated on the 4th Thursday of November, but the following day, Friday, is also a holiday and then comes the weekend.
diff_details.old: 在美国，感恩节在11月的第四个星期四庆祝，但接下来的那天，星期五，也是假日，然后就是周末。

diff_details.en: In Canada, Thanksgiving is celebrated on the second Monday of October.
diff_details.old: 加拿大感恩节是在十月的第二个星期一庆祝的。

diff_details.en: The reason for the earlier celebration in Canada is that the weather is colder than in the United States.
diff_details.old: 加拿大提前庆祝的原因是因为那里的天气比美国冷。

diff_details.en: This means that the harvest happens earlier in Canada, so Thanksgiving is held at an earlier date.
diff_details.old: 这意味着加拿大的收获时间更早，所以感恩节也提前了。

diff_details.en: But in both countries, Thanksgiving is a very pleasant time of year.
diff_details.old: 但在两个国家，感恩节都是非常愉快的一年中的时光。
